title: The Tea That Tastes of Old Sandals

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a healer or elder)

collection.description: A healer offers a worried villager a calming tea that tastes like an old sandal: drink it with honey, or ask for something else.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been worrying so much lately that (subject.he/she) can't settle in the evenings. (friend) has brewed (subject.him/her) a calming tea from bark and a little grey leaf. "Some people find it helps," says (friend). "Some don't. And I'll be honest with you: it tastes like an old sandal." (subject) sniffs it. (friend) was not exaggerating.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "I don't think I can drink this every night," says (subject). "Is there another way?" (friend) isn't offended in the least. "There's always another way. Some people walk in the evenings. Some lie down with a warm stone on the chest. Try the stone first. It tastes of nothing." (subject) tries the stone. It's oddly comforting. The sandal tea goes back on the shelf for someone braver.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Can I put honey in it?" asks (subject). "As much as you like," says (friend). (subject) puts in so much honey the spoon nearly stands up. It still tastes faintly of sandal. (subject.He/she) drinks it every evening for a week. (subject.He/she) does seem to settle a little easier. Or maybe it's the honey. Neither of them is sure, and neither of them minds.
